from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialMetric(BaseModel):
    """Financial metric extracted from a single company's report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company reporting the data")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period, e.g., '2025-03-31'")
    monetary_funds: float | None = Field(description="Monetary funds (currency units) for the numerator")
    accounts_payable: float | None = Field(description="Accounts payable (currency units) for the denominator")
    contract_liabilities: float | None = Field(description="Contract liabilities (currency units) for the denominator")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Schema to capture financial data from one document."""
    metrics: list[FinancialMetric] = Field(description="List of financial metric instances found in the document")
